name: Nintendo Wii U
significance: Laid the design and engineering foundation for the hybrid architecture that would achieve astronomical success with the Nintendo Switch.

verifiedFactualData.ram: 2 GB DDR3 RAM (1 GB dedicated to games, 1 GB to OS)

editorialContent.overview: Nintendo's experimental dual-screen home console, introducing off-TV streaming play and asymmetric game design.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: Laid the design and engineering foundation for the hybrid architecture that would achieve astronomical success with the Nintendo Switch.
